challenges.name: Multilingual Proficiency
challenges.description: Find an object or a sign containing trilingual text.

challenges.name: Library on Wheels
challenges.description: Move a book between two little free libraries within the same neighborhood.

challenges.name: Words of Affirmation
challenges.description: Write a note with a positive message and at least 3 sentences and slip it into a mailbox.

challenges.name: The Floor is Lava
challenges.description: Travel a distance of at least 800 meters, measured between your start and end points, without your feet ever touching a paved road or sidewalk.

challenges.name: Frankenstein
challenges.description: One teammate stands closely behind the other, wrapping their arms around the front teammate to act as their hands. The front teammate must keep their real hands firmly in their pockets. The back teammate must successfully unscrew a water bottle, pouring a sip of water into the front teammate's mouth, and screwing the cap back on without spilling.

challenges.name: The Marionette
challenges.description: Teammate A must put on a jacket or hoodie. However, Teammate A must act as a rigid mannequin, keeping their arms completely stiff and unhelpful. Teammate B must physically manipulate, lift, and bend Teammate A's arms and body to get the garment fully on and successfully zipped or buttoned up.

challenges.name: Gift For Pyo
challenges.description: Photograph 6 and 7 on the same sign.

challenges.name: Fruit Roll
challenges.description: Roll an orange on a street for 20 meters.

challenges.name: Miss Banana
challenges.description: Balance a banana on your head while walking 50 meters.

challenges.name: Mirror Selfie
challenges.description: Take a picture of yourself in a mirror. It must be an actual mirror and not just glass; vehicle mirrors are not allowed.

challenges.name: Ape Activity
challenges.description: One member must climb a tree. Take a picture of yourself perched atop a branch of the tree.

challenges.name: Bounty Hunter
challenges.description: Photograph a missing pet poster.

challenges.name: Embrace the Arts
challenges.description: Visit a museum or gallery for at least 5 mins.

challenges.name: Traffic Calming
challenges.description: Find a residential street intersection that features a physical concrete traffic diverter or median that explicitly blocks vehicle through-traffic but allows bicycles to pass. Take a photo standing on the diverter.

challenges.name: Prime Buses
challenges.description: Take a bus whose route number is prime.

challenges.name: The Great Gatsby
challenges.description: Photograph a yellow car.

challenges.name: Gambling Addiction
challenges.description: Find a deck of playing cards.

challenges.name: Friends Forever
challenges.description: Find a player's name in text.

challenges.name: Canadian Literature
challenges.description: Go to a library or bookstore and find a book written by a Canadian author.

challenges.name: Math Minute
challenges.description: Go to a secondary school and complete 40 correct times tables in 1 minute.

challenges.name: Song With Words
challenges.description: Find a book and sing a song using the book's text as lyrics. You must sing at least 4 sentences to the tune of a famous Christmas carol.

challenges.name: Candied Fruit
challenges.description: Find and photograph candy with the flavor of any teammate’s fruit.

challenges.name: Musically Inclined
challenges.description: Find and photograph yourselves with a musical instrument.

challenges.name: Colors of the Wind
challenges.description: Lift and hold in your hands three objects, each of one of the three primary colors (red, yellow, blue).

challenges.name: Shakespeare
challenges.description: Compose a poem in honor of your neighborhood. The poem must be at least 8 lines, mention content unique to your neighbourhood, and every line must rhyme with at least one other line. Using generative artificial intelligence is not allowed.

challenges.name: Wheelbarrow
challenges.description: Complete a 15 meter human wheelbarrow walk (one person walking on their hands while the partner holds their ankles).

challenges.name: Double Chorus
challenges.description: Sing the chorus of a song by alternating words. You must complete it with no mistakes, recording the successful run.

challenges.name: Move as One
challenges.description: One teammate must completely retie their own shoe. One teammate may only use their left hand, and the other may only use their right hand. Your other hands must remain firmly in your pockets. Film the entire retying process.

challenges.name: Monkey See Monkey Do
challenges.description: Swing on monkey bars at a playground.

challenges.name: Hydration Break
challenges.description: Take a photo with a natural body of water.

challenges.name: Bob the Builder
challenges.description: Photograph yourself next to a structure formally under construction.

challenges.name: Break Time
challenges.description: Photograph a transit vehicle that is not in service. The vehicle must display not in service or an otherwise equivalent phrase.

challenges.name: While True
challenges.description: Find a traffic circle, or a cul-de-sac. You must physically travel through/around it for three complete, uninterrupted rotations.

challenges.name: Bus Mania
challenges.description: Take a photo with at least 4 buses in frame.

challenges.name: Hello World
challenges.description: Find a publicly available computer and write a hello world program.

challenges.name: Ape Illiteracy
challenges.description: Read a full page of a young adult or adult novel out loud in reverse order.

challenges.name: Medical Monitoring
challenges.description: Measure your teammate’s pulse manually for at least 30 seconds in front of a hospital, clinic, or medical center.

challenges.name: Devolution on Display
challenges.description: Find a book that discusses the evolution of humans.

battles.name: International Baccalaureate
battles.description: Find the most country flags.

battles.name: Food Court
battles.description: Be the first unit to go to a shopping center/mall and eat something.

battles.name: Express Transit
battles.description: Board any form of transit the fastest.

battles.name: License Plate Hunt
battles.description: Find the license plate that is closest to the start of the alphanumeric sequence (ASCII). Numbers come before letters (0-9, then A-Z).

battles.name: Far From Home
battles.description: Get as far away as possible from a transit station or stop (including subway stations and bus stops).

battles.name: Fruit Market
battles.description: Find the most members of the fruit market as a flavor. The members of the fruit market include Orange, Banana, Grape, Peach, Pineapple, Pear, Apple, Mango, Coconut.

battles.name: Unrotten Fruits
battles.description: Photograph as many unique types of fresh fruits as possible. These must be real pieces of fruit. Packaged fruit snacks do not count.

battles.name: Deflation
battles.description: Find the largest sale percentage.

battles.name: Haute Couture
battles.description: Find the most expensive piece of clothing (accessories do not count). Your photo must include the price of the item.

battles.name: Transit Tracking
battles.description: Photograph as many different bus route numbers as possible. The numbers must be visible on the digital displays of physical, active buses.

battles.name: World Traveler
battles.description: Photograph written text in as many different languages as possible on public signage. Translations on your own smartphones or personal items do not count.

battles.name: Rainbow Dash
battles.description: Upload 7 distinct photos of real-world objects, one for each color of the rainbow (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, Violet) the fastest.

battles.name: Escape Hatch
battles.description: Take a photo in front of an emergency exit sign the fastest.

battles.name: Bank Heist
battles.description: Withdraw money from an ATM in a bank branch the fastest.

battles.name: Happy Birthday
battles.description: Find your year of birth in text the fastest.

battles.name: The Spirit of Christmas
battles.description: Photograph as many Santa Clauses as possible. Can be an image or a physical likeness.

battles.name: Cargo Delivery
battles.description: Photograph the most active delivery or logistics vehicles (such as FedEx, UPS, Canada Post, Amazon).

battles.name: Queued
battles.description: Photograph the longest queue. You may not be a part of the queue.

battles.name: Urban Engineering
battles.description: In a public park or green space, build a freestanding structure as tall as possible using only loose, found natural materials (sticks, pinecones, rocks, etc.). It must stand for at least 5 seconds.

battles.name: TransBreak
battles.description: Go to a bus stop whose next bus is scheduled to arrive the latest.

battles.name: Multicultural City
battles.description: Find a language that is the least spoken in the metropolitan area, according to Wikipedia.
